_**Kumkum Bhagya**_ (transl._Vermillion in My Fate_) is an Indian [Hindi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi "Hindi")-language [romantic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romance_film#Romantic_drama "Romance film")[melodrama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melodrama "Melodrama") television series produced by [Ekta Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor") under [Balaji Telefilms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balaji_Telefilms "Balaji Telefilms").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-IExp-6) It aired from 15 April 2014 to 21 September 2025 on [Zee TV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zee_TV "Zee TV") and digitally streams on [ZEE5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ZEE5 "ZEE5").[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-hindustantimes.com-7) It starred [Sriti Jha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sriti_Jha "Sriti Jha"), [Shabir Ahluwalia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia "Shabir Ahluwalia"), [Mugdha Chaphekar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mugdha_Chaphekar "Mugdha Chaphekar"), Krishna Kaul, [Rachi Sharma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rachi_Sharma "Rachi Sharma"), [Abrar Qazi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrar_Qazi "Abrar Qazi"), [Pranali Rathod](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pranali_Rathod "Pranali Rathod") and [Namik Paul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namik_Paul "Namik Paul") in lead roles. One of the [longest running Indian television soap opera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_longest-running_Indian_television_series "List of longest-running Indian television series"), the concept of the show was originally based on [Jane Austen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Austen "Jane Austen")'s novel _[Sense and Sensibility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sense\_and\_Sensibility "Sense and Sensibility")_.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Sensibility-1)

## Plot

The series begins with Pragya Arora, a college lecturer, and Abhishek “Abhi” Mehra, a wealthy rock star, whose marriage is arranged through family intervention. Their relationship is initially strained due to manipulations by Abhi’s sister Aliya and his former partner Tanu. The narrative follows repeated misunderstandings, conspiracies, memory-loss incidents, and separations. Despite numerous obstacles, Pragya and Abhi reconcile multiple times. The birth of their twin daughters, Prachi and Rhea, coincides with another major separation, leading to the children being raised apart.

After a twenty-year leap, the story focuses on Prachi Arora and Rhea Mehra, who grow up unaware they are twin sisters. Prachi develops a relationship with Ranbir Kohli, while Rhea’s feelings for him create rivalry. Family interference and concealed truths complicate their lives until the sisters’ true parentage is revealed. Although Abhi and Pragya briefly reunite with their daughters, continued misunderstandings affect the family. Prachi eventually marries Ranbir, but their relationship faces many challenges arising from Ranbir's family, Rhea's obsession for Ranbir and many other misunderstandings.

A further leap introduces Prachi and Ranbir’s daughters, Khushi and Poorvi. Raised in different circumstances due to family conflict, the sisters’ lives unfold amid hidden identities and inherited tensions. Poorvi’s relationship with Rajvansh Malhotra becomes central to this phase. As past grievances resurface, the family once again confronts separation and reconciliation.

Another generational transition introduces new protagonists, including Prarthana Parikh and Shivansh Randhawa, whose lives intersect through family and business alliances connected to earlier characters. Their relationship is shaped by mistrust, rivalry, and concealed motives. While legacy figures appear intermittently, the storyline centres on the younger generation navigating conflicts rooted in the family’s past, continuing the series’ recurring themes of destiny and reunion.

## Production

### Development

The series is a [love story](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romance_(love) "Romance (love)")[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-8) produced by [Ekta Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor") and [Shobha Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shobha_Kapoor "Shobha Kapoor") under the banner [Balaji Telefilms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balaji_Telefilms "Balaji Telefilms") that airs on Zee TV. Ekta Kapoor considers the letter _K_ to be lucky and has named many of her productions starting with _K_.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-9)

Kapoor rejected 19 costumes while selecting the look of character Pragya.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-10)

### Filming

The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the [COVID-19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19 "COVID-19") outbreak in India.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-11) The outbreak caused the halt of filming of television shows and movies on 19 March 2020, and they were expected to resume on 1 April 2020. But shooting remained suspended and the remaining episodes were aired up to 24 March 2020.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-14) After three months, the production and filming of the series resumed on 29 June 2020 and airing resumed on 13 July 2020.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-17)

### Casting

[Shabbir Ahluwalia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabbir_Ahluwalia "Shabbir Ahluwalia"),[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-inidatoday-18) who was also cast in Ekta's TV series _[Kayamath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kayamath "Kayamath")_, was selected to portray the lead role of Abhishek Prem Mehra. Ahluwalia made his comeback after Zee twenty years. Actress [Sriti Jha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sriti_Jha "Sriti Jha") landed the lead role in the show.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-inidatoday-18)[Mrunal Thakur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mrunal_Thakur "Mrunal Thakur") was selected to portray the second leading role of Bulbul[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-indiatoday.intoday.in-19) while [Arjit Taneja](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arjit_Taneja "Arjit Taneja") was cast opposite her.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-indiatoday.intoday.in-19)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Shikha-20) In May 2014, [Shikha Singh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shikha_Singh "Shikha Singh") entered the show as the main antagonist Alia Mehra,[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Shikha-20)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-IndiaToday-21)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-auto-22) while [Madhurima Tuli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madhurima_Tuli "Madhurima Tuli") was cast to portray the negative role of Tanu. Later, Tuli had to shoot for her film [_Baby_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baby_(2015_Hindi_film) "Baby (2015 Hindi film)") so, this role was later played by [Leena Jumani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leena_Jumani "Leena Jumani") from September 2014.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Leena-23) Actor Faisal Rashid was selected to portray the role of Suresh (Pragya's fiancé) who played an important role in April–May 2014, but in May 2015 he quit the series. Actress Supriya Shukla was cast to play the role of Sarla Arora, while Madhu Raja played the role of Daljeet Arora. Other supporting cast members include [Samikssha Batnagar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samikssha_Batnagar "Samikssha Batnagar"), [Ankit Mohan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ankit_Mohan "Ankit Mohan"), Charu Mehra and Amit Dhawan. Bhatnagar, who portrayed the supporting role of Mitali was replaced by Swati Anand within the month of launch while [Anurag Sharma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anurag_Sharma_(actor) "Anurag Sharma (actor)") replaced Amit. In 2015, Neel Motawani (who was also cast in other shows of Ekta) was selected to play the negative role of Neel; while in June 2015 Nikhil Arya entered the series playing the role of main male antagonist Nikhil Sood.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-24)

In December 2015, Mrunal Thakur opted out from the show and was to be replaced by Kajol Shrivastava, however the character of Bulbul was phased out of the series after Mrunal's departure. In August 2016, Ankit Mohan quit the show so his character left as well. In September 2016, Arjit Taneja quit the show and was replaced by [Vin Rana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vin_Rana "Vin Rana"). In October 2016, Nikhil Arya was replaced by Rujut Dahiya.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Nikhil-25) In July 2017, actress [Ruchi Savarn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruchi_Savarn "Ruchi Savarn") entered the show as Purab's new love interest. Mishal Raheja as King Singh and Kaurwakee Vashista as Kiara Mehra entered the show after the leap. Actor Abeer Adil was cast in 2018 as King's cousin Tarun and Roma Bali as Tarun's mother.

In March 2019, a twenty-year leap was introduced with which several new characters entered in the show and became pivotal characters. In March 2019, [Mugdha Chaphekar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mugdha_Chaphekar "Mugdha Chaphekar"), Krishna Kaul and [Naina Singh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naina_Singh "Naina Singh") were introduced as leads of the second generation who play Prachi, Ranbir and Rhea respectively alongside Sriti and Shabbir. In August 2020, Naina left the show as she was not happy playing a negative role anymore and [Pooja Banerjee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pooja_Banerjee "Pooja Banerjee") replaced Singh as Rhea. In February 2022, Pooja Banerjee quit the show due to her pregnancy, and she was replaced by[Tina Ann Philip](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tina_Ann_Philip "Tina Ann Philip").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-26) In February 2022, Jha and Ahluwalia officially quit the show after seven and half years as the story progressed on from their characters. They had last shot for the show in November 2021.

The show then took another generation leap of twenty years in November 2023, with [Rachi Sharma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rachi_Sharma "Rachi Sharma") and [Abrar Qazi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrar_Qazi "Abrar Qazi") roped in as the new leads of generation three with Sharma portraying Prachi and Ranbir's younger daughter Poorvi Kohli while Qazi as Rajvansh Malhotra respectively.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-27)

Simran Budharup was roped in to play grown-up version of Prachi and Ranbir's elder daughter Khushi Kohli Randhawa replacing Trisha Rohatgi who played childhood version of same. Later Budhraup quit the show owing to less screenspace and was replaced by [Jyotsna Chandola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jyotsna_Chandola "Jyotsna Chandola"). Later, Chaphekar and Kaul who portrayed leads of generation two, their role roles came to an indefinite end in June 2024 and in September 2024 media confirmed the news that both are no longer part of the show. In an Interview from 2025, Chaphekar and Kaul said that they weren't aware that their shoot in June 2024 would be their last for show and that they were informed much later that their characters will not be brought back to the show causing the second generation story to end without any conclusion.

In February 2025, the show again took a 20-year generation leap, with [Pranali Rathod](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pranali_Rathod "Pranali Rathod") and Akshay Bindra as new generation leads. However later Bindra's character was sidelined as Supporting character and [Namik Paul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namik_Paul "Namik Paul") stepped in as new male lead.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-28)

[Abrar Qazi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrar_Qazi "Abrar Qazi") and Rachi Sharma and other supporting casts marked their exits due to the generation leap.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-29) In March 2025, Rachi Sharma was again roped in to reprise her role of Poorvi Malhotra as a cameo to revive dipping TRPs. She was again roped in for a second appearance in April 2025. Soon after it was also confirmed that [Shraddha Arya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shraddha_Arya "Shraddha Arya") and [Shakti Anand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shakti_Anand "Shakti Anand") would also be joining _Kumkum Bhagya_ reprising their characters Karan and Preeta from _[Kundali Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kundali\_Bhagya "Kundali Bhagya")_.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-31) However soon after their roles also ended and the show eventually went off air in September 2025 owing to low TRPs over a year.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-32)[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-33)

## Spin-off

### Kundali Bhagya

Main article: [Kundali Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kundali_Bhagya "Kundali Bhagya")

A spin-off series _[Kundali Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kundali\_Bhagya "Kundali Bhagya")_ premiered on 12 July 2017 and ran till 6 December 2024. The series narrated the story of Pragya's sisters, Preeta and Srishti and their attempt to find their mother Sarla and how they meet the rich and famous Luthra family. Later that show too took a generation leap and story shifted to Preeta's sons Rajveer and Shaurya.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-34)[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-36)

## Reception

### Critical reception

> Here's celebrating a show that has stood the test of time and crossed the boundaries of language, a big thank you to each and every one of you from all over the world for all the love you have given _Kumkum Bhagya_, for always keeping it at the top, no matter where it aired, and what language. We, as a team, are truly grateful that you let us entertain you for half a decade.

—[Shabir Ahluwalia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia "Shabir Ahluwalia") on the series completing 5 Years.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-39)

Reruns of Kumkum Bhagya premiered on [Zee Anmol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zee_Anmol "Zee Anmol") from 2017 and received high ratings in the BARC rural chart when Zee Anmol was [FTA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free-to-air "Free-to-air"). It began running on the network again from episode 1 from 10 June 2020, due to the return to [DD Free Dish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DD_Free_Dish "DD Free Dish").[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

The show also managed to strike a chord with West Africans too.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-40) Actor [Kartik Aaryan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kartik_Aaryan "Kartik Aaryan") also watched the show during the lockdown.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-42)

### Ratings

_Kumkum Bhagya_ premiered on 15 April 2014, climbed to Top 5 most-watched shows across all GECs, after only a few weeks of its launch.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-43) It was touted as the biggest fiction launch of 2014.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-44)

The show topped the TRP chart in week 43 of 2015 with 4.5 points, ahead of _[Saath Nibhaana Saathiya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saath\_Nibhaana\_Saathiya "Saath Nibhaana Saathiya")_ and _[Yeh Hai Mohabbatein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yeh\_Hai\_Mohabbatein "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein")_.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-45) By week 11 of 2016, it had slipped to second with 3.8 points, behind _[Naagin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naagin\_(2015\_TV\_series) "Naagin (2015 TV series)")_.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-46)

Mid-2016 it recorded peak [TRPs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Television_Rating_Point "Television Rating Point"), led the chart in weeks 28 and 29,[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-47)[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-48) and by week 34 had held the top spot for six consecutive weeks.[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-49)[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-50) The following week ( Aug– Sep) it drew 12.6 million viewers, up from 12.2 million, still at number one.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-52) By week 37 it had topped the chart a seventh time, at 12,636 points.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-53) It fell out of the top five the week after.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-54) In week 27 of 2017, it got 12,209 impressions at first place.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-55) Throughout 2017, it recorded ratings of 2.7, 3.3, 3.4, 3.2 in weeks 35, 37, 38, 52 respectively.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-56)

In July 2020, the show occupied second position with 4.9 million impressions.[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-57) By December 2020, it fell to fifth position with 5,409 impressions.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-58) By January 2021, it rose back to fifth with 6,288 impressions.[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-59)

_**Kumkum Bhagya**_ (transl._Vermillion in My Fate_) is an Indian [Hindi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi "Hindi")-language [romantic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romance_film#Romantic_drama "Romance film")[melodrama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melodrama "Melodrama") television series produced by [Ekta Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor") under [Balaji Telefilms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balaji_Telefilms "Balaji Telefilms").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-IExp-6) It aired from 15 April 2014 to 21 September 2025 on [Zee TV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zee_TV "Zee TV") and digitally streams on [ZEE5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ZEE5 "ZEE5").[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-hindustantimes.com-7) It starred [Sriti Jha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sriti_Jha "Sriti Jha"), [Shabir Ahluwalia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia "Shabir Ahluwalia"), [Mugdha Chaphekar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mugdha_Chaphekar "Mugdha Chaphekar"), Krishna Kaul, [Rachi Sharma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rachi_Sharma "Rachi Sharma"), [Abrar Qazi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrar_Qazi "Abrar Qazi"), [Pranali Rathod](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pranali_Rathod "Pranali Rathod") and [Namik Paul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namik_Paul "Namik Paul") in lead roles. One of the [longest running Indian television soap opera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_longest-running_Indian_television_series "List of longest-running Indian television series"), the concept of the show was originally based on [Jane Austen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Austen "Jane Austen")'s novel _[Sense and Sensibility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sense\_and\_Sensibility "Sense and Sensibility")_.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Sensibility-1)

## Plot

The series begins with Pragya Arora, a college lecturer, and Abhishek “Abhi” Mehra, a wealthy rock star, whose marriage is arranged through family intervention. Their relationship is initially strained due to manipulations by Abhi’s sister Aliya and his former partner Tanu. The narrative follows repeated misunderstandings, conspiracies, memory-loss incidents, and separations. Despite numerous obstacles, Pragya and Abhi reconcile multiple times. The birth of their twin daughters, Prachi and Rhea, coincides with another major separation, leading to the children being raised apart.

After a twenty-year leap, the story focuses on Prachi Arora and Rhea Mehra, who grow up unaware they are twin sisters. Prachi develops a relationship with Ranbir Kohli, while Rhea’s feelings for him create rivalry. Family interference and concealed truths complicate their lives until the sisters’ true parentage is revealed. Although Abhi and Pragya briefly reunite with their daughters, continued misunderstandings affect the family. Prachi eventually marries Ranbir, but their relationship faces many challenges arising from Ranbir's family, Rhea's obsession for Ranbir and many other misunderstandings.

A further leap introduces Prachi and Ranbir’s daughters, Khushi and Poorvi. Raised in different circumstances due to family conflict, the sisters’ lives unfold amid hidden identities and inherited tensions. Poorvi’s relationship with Rajvansh Malhotra becomes central to this phase. As past grievances resurface, the family once again confronts separation and reconciliation.

Another generational transition introduces new protagonists, including Prarthana Parikh and Shivansh Randhawa, whose lives intersect through family and business alliances connected to earlier characters. Their relationship is shaped by mistrust, rivalry, and concealed motives. While legacy figures appear intermittently, the storyline centres on the younger generation navigating conflicts rooted in the family’s past, continuing the series’ recurring themes of destiny and reunion.

## Production

### Development

The series is a [love story](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romance_(love) "Romance (love)")[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-8) produced by [Ekta Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor") and [Shobha Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shobha_Kapoor "Shobha Kapoor") under the banner [Balaji Telefilms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balaji_Telefilms "Balaji Telefilms") that airs on Zee TV. Ekta Kapoor considers the letter _K_ to be lucky and has named many of her productions starting with _K_.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-9)

Kapoor rejected 19 costumes while selecting the look of character Pragya.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-10)

### Filming

The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the [COVID-19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19 "COVID-19") outbreak in India.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-11) The outbreak caused the halt of filming of television shows and movies on 19 March 2020, and they were expected to resume on 1 April 2020. But shooting remained suspended and the remaining episodes were aired up to 24 March 2020.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-14) After three months, the production and filming of the series resumed on 29 June 2020 and airing resumed on 13 July 2020.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-17)

### Casting

[Shabbir Ahluwalia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabbir_Ahluwalia "Shabbir Ahluwalia"),[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-inidatoday-18) who was also cast in Ekta's TV series _[Kayamath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kayamath "Kayamath")_, was selected to portray the lead role of Abhishek Prem Mehra. Ahluwalia made his comeback after Zee twenty years. Actress [Sriti Jha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sriti_Jha "Sriti Jha") landed the lead role in the show.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-inidatoday-18)[Mrunal Thakur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mrunal_Thakur "Mrunal Thakur") was selected to portray the second leading role of Bulbul[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-indiatoday.intoday.in-19) while [Arjit Taneja](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arjit_Taneja "Arjit Taneja") was cast opposite her.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-indiatoday.intoday.in-19)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Shikha-20) In May 2014, [Shikha Singh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shikha_Singh "Shikha Singh") entered the show as the main antagonist Alia Mehra,[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Shikha-20)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-IndiaToday-21)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-auto-22) while [Madhurima Tuli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madhurima_Tuli "Madhurima Tuli") was cast to portray the negative role of Tanu. Later, Tuli had to shoot for her film [_Baby_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baby_(2015_Hindi_film) "Baby (2015 Hindi film)") so, this role was later played by [Leena Jumani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leena_Jumani "Leena Jumani") from September 2014.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Leena-23) Actor Faisal Rashid was selected to portray the role of Suresh (Pragya's fiancé) who played an important role in April–May 2014, but in May 2015 he quit the series. Actress Supriya Shukla was cast to play the role of Sarla Arora, while Madhu Raja played the role of Daljeet Arora. Other supporting cast members include [Samikssha Batnagar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samikssha_Batnagar "Samikssha Batnagar"), [Ankit Mohan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ankit_Mohan "Ankit Mohan"), Charu Mehra and Amit Dhawan. Bhatnagar, who portrayed the supporting role of Mitali was replaced by Swati Anand within the month of launch while [Anurag Sharma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anurag_Sharma_(actor) "Anurag Sharma (actor)") replaced Amit. In 2015, Neel Motawani (who was also cast in other shows of Ekta) was selected to play the negative role of Neel; while in June 2015 Nikhil Arya entered the series playing the role of main male antagonist Nikhil Sood.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-24)

In December 2015, Mrunal Thakur opted out from the show and was to be replaced by Kajol Shrivastava, however the character of Bulbul was phased out of the series after Mrunal's departure. In August 2016, Ankit Mohan quit the show so his character left as well. In September 2016, Arjit Taneja quit the show and was replaced by [Vin Rana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vin_Rana "Vin Rana"). In October 2016, Nikhil Arya was replaced by Rujut Dahiya.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-Nikhil-25) In July 2017, actress [Ruchi Savarn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruchi_Savarn "Ruchi Savarn") entered the show as Purab's new love interest. Mishal Raheja as King Singh and Kaurwakee Vashista as Kiara Mehra entered the show after the leap. Actor Abeer Adil was cast in 2018 as King's cousin Tarun and Roma Bali as Tarun's mother.

In March 2019, a twenty-year leap was introduced with which several new characters entered in the show and became pivotal characters. In March 2019, [Mugdha Chaphekar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mugdha_Chaphekar "Mugdha Chaphekar"), Krishna Kaul and [Naina Singh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naina_Singh "Naina Singh") were introduced as leads of the second generation who play Prachi, Ranbir and Rhea respectively alongside Sriti and Shabbir. In August 2020, Naina left the show as she was not happy playing a negative role anymore and [Pooja Banerjee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pooja_Banerjee "Pooja Banerjee") replaced Singh as Rhea. In February 2022, Pooja Banerjee quit the show due to her pregnancy, and she was replaced by[Tina Ann Philip](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tina_Ann_Philip "Tina Ann Philip").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-26) In February 2022, Jha and Ahluwalia officially quit the show after seven and half years as the story progressed on from their characters. They had last shot for the show in November 2021.

The show then took another generation leap of twenty years in November 2023, with [Rachi Sharma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rachi_Sharma "Rachi Sharma") and [Abrar Qazi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrar_Qazi "Abrar Qazi") roped in as the new leads of generation three with Sharma portraying Prachi and Ranbir's younger daughter Poorvi Kohli while Qazi as Rajvansh Malhotra respectively.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-27)

Simran Budharup was roped in to play grown-up version of Prachi and Ranbir's elder daughter Khushi Kohli Randhawa replacing Trisha Rohatgi who played childhood version of same. Later Budhraup quit the show owing to less screenspace and was replaced by [Jyotsna Chandola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jyotsna_Chandola "Jyotsna Chandola"). Later, Chaphekar and Kaul who portrayed leads of generation two, their role roles came to an indefinite end in June 2024 and in September 2024 media confirmed the news that both are no longer part of the show. In an Interview from 2025, Chaphekar and Kaul said that they weren't aware that their shoot in June 2024 would be their last for show and that they were informed much later that their characters will not be brought back to the show causing the second generation story to end without any conclusion.

In February 2025, the show again took a 20-year generation leap, with [Pranali Rathod](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pranali_Rathod "Pranali Rathod") and Akshay Bindra as new generation leads. However later Bindra's character was sidelined as Supporting character and [Namik Paul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namik_Paul "Namik Paul") stepped in as new male lead.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-28)

[Abrar Qazi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrar_Qazi "Abrar Qazi") and Rachi Sharma and other supporting casts marked their exits due to the generation leap.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-29) In March 2025, Rachi Sharma was again roped in to reprise her role of Poorvi Malhotra as a cameo to revive dipping TRPs. She was again roped in for a second appearance in April 2025. Soon after it was also confirmed that [Shraddha Arya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shraddha_Arya "Shraddha Arya") and [Shakti Anand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shakti_Anand "Shakti Anand") would also be joining _Kumkum Bhagya_ reprising their characters Karan and Preeta from _[Kundali Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kundali\_Bhagya "Kundali Bhagya")_.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-31) However soon after their roles also ended and the show eventually went off air in September 2025 owing to low TRPs over a year.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-32)[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-33)

## Spin-off

### Kundali Bhagya

Main article: [Kundali Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kundali_Bhagya "Kundali Bhagya")

A spin-off series _[Kundali Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kundali\_Bhagya "Kundali Bhagya")_ premiered on 12 July 2017 and ran till 6 December 2024. The series narrated the story of Pragya's sisters, Preeta and Srishti and their attempt to find their mother Sarla and how they meet the rich and famous Luthra family. Later that show too took a generation leap and story shifted to Preeta's sons Rajveer and Shaurya.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-34)[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-36)

### Bhagya Lakshmi

Main article: [Bhagya Lakshmi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagya_Lakshmi "Bhagya Lakshmi")

A similar series _[Bhagya Lakshmi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagya\_Lakshmi "Bhagya Lakshmi")_ premiered on 3 August 2021 and ran till 29 June 2025. It traces the love story of Pragya's best friend, Lakshmi and Rishi. It stars [Aishwarya Khare](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aishwarya_Khare "Aishwarya Khare") and [Rohit Suchanti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rohit_Suchanti "Rohit Suchanti").[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-37)[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-38)

## Reception

### Critical reception

> Here's celebrating a show that has stood the test of time and crossed the boundaries of language, a big thank you to each and every one of you from all over the world for all the love you have given _Kumkum Bhagya_, for always keeping it at the top, no matter where it aired, and what language. We, as a team, are truly grateful that you let us entertain you for half a decade.

—[Shabir Ahluwalia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia "Shabir Ahluwalia") on the series completing 5 Years.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-39)

Reruns of Kumkum Bhagya premiered on [Zee Anmol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zee_Anmol "Zee Anmol") from 2017 and received high ratings in the BARC rural chart when Zee Anmol was [FTA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free-to-air "Free-to-air"). It began running on the network again from episode 1 from 10 June 2020, due to the return to [DD Free Dish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DD_Free_Dish "DD Free Dish").[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

The show also managed to strike a chord with West Africans too.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-40) Actor [Kartik Aaryan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kartik_Aaryan "Kartik Aaryan") also watched the show during the lockdown.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-42)

### Ratings

_Kumkum Bhagya_ premiered on 15 April 2014, climbed to Top 5 most-watched shows across all GECs, after only a few weeks of its launch.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-43) It was touted as the biggest fiction launch of 2014.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-44)

The show topped the TRP chart in week 43 of 2015 with 4.5 points, ahead of _[Saath Nibhaana Saathiya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saath\_Nibhaana\_Saathiya "Saath Nibhaana Saathiya")_ and _[Yeh Hai Mohabbatein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yeh\_Hai\_Mohabbatein "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein")_.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-45) By week 11 of 2016, it had slipped to second with 3.8 points, behind _[Naagin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naagin\_(2015\_TV\_series) "Naagin (2015 TV series)")_.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-46)

Mid-2016 it recorded peak [TRPs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Television_Rating_Point "Television Rating Point"), led the chart in weeks 28 and 29,[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-47)[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-48) and by week 34 had held the top spot for six consecutive weeks.[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-49)[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-50) The following week ( Aug– Sep) it drew 12.6 million viewers, up from 12.2 million, still at number one.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-52) By week 37 it had topped the chart a seventh time, at 12,636 points.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-53) It fell out of the top five the week after.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-54) In week 27 of 2017, it got 12,209 impressions at first place.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-55) Throughout 2017, it recorded ratings of 2.7, 3.3, 3.4, 3.2 in weeks 35, 37, 38, 52 respectively.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-56)

In July 2020, the show occupied second position with 4.9 million impressions.[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-57) By December 2020, it fell to fifth position with 5,409 impressions.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-58) By January 2021, it rose back to fifth with 6,288 impressions.[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum_Bhagya#cite_note-59)

**Shabir Ahluwalia** (born 10 August 1979) is an Indian actor and host who works in Hindi television and films. He is best known for portraying Abhishek Prem Mehra in [Zee TV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zee_TV "Zee TV")'s romantic drama series _[Kumkum Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum\_Bhagya "Kumkum Bhagya")_. He won the third season of _[Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fear\_Factor:\_Khatron\_Ke\_Khiladi "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi")_ and hosted _[Nach Baliye](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nach\_Baliye "Nach Baliye")_, _[Guinness World Records – Ab India Todega](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guinness\_World\_Records\_%E2%80%93\_Ab\_India\_Todega "Guinness World Records – Ab India Todega")_ and _[Dancing Queen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing\_Queen\_(2008\_Indian\_TV\_series) "Dancing Queen (2008 Indian TV series)")_.

Apart from this, Ahluwalia has acted in _[Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyunki\_Saas\_Bhi\_Kabhi\_Bahu\_Thi "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi")_ (2002), _[Kya Hadsaa Kya Haqeeqat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kya\_Hadsaa\_Kya\_Haqeeqat "Kya Hadsaa Kya Haqeeqat")_ (2004), _[Kahi To Milenge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahi\_To\_Milenge "Kahi To Milenge")_ (2002), _[Kkavyanjali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kkavyanjali "Kkavyanjali")_ (2005), _[Kasamh Se](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasamh\_Se "Kasamh Se")_ (2006), _[Kasautii Zindagii Kay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasautii\_Zindagii\_Kay\_(2001\_TV\_series) "Kasautii Zindagii Kay (2001 TV series)")_ (2006), _[Kayamath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kayamath "Kayamath")_ (2007), _[Laagi Tujhse Lagan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laagi\_Tujhse\_Lagan "Laagi Tujhse Lagan")_ (2011) and many more. He made his debut in [Bollywood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bollywood "Bollywood") with _[Shootout at Lokhandwala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shootout\_at\_Lokhandwala "Shootout at Lokhandwala")_. His second film was _[Mission Istanbul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission\_Istanbul "Mission Istanbul")_.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-sify1-4)

## Life and family

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shabir_Ahluwalia&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Life and family")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Kanchi_kaul_shabbir_ahluwalia_Bollywood_%26_TV_actors_at_Ekta_Kapoor%27s_birthday_bash.jpg/250px-Kanchi_kaul_shabbir_ahluwalia_Bollywood_%26_TV_actors_at_Ekta_Kapoor%27s_birthday_bash.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Kanchi_kaul_shabbir_ahluwalia_Bollywood_&_TV_actors_at_Ekta_Kapoor's_birthday_bash.jpg)

With wife [Kanchi Kaul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanchi_Kaul "Kanchi Kaul") at [Ekta Kapoors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor") Birthday

Shabir Ahluwalia was born on 10 August 1979 to a [Sikh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sikh "Sikh") father and a [Catholic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic "Catholic") mother in [Mumbai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mumbai "Mumbai").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-birth-1) He has two siblings Shefali Ahluwalia and Sameer Ahluwalia. He did his schooling from [St. Xavier's High School, Vile Parle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Xavier's_High_School,_Vile_Parle "St. Xavier's High School, Vile Parle").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-indiatimes.com-5) He completed his graduation from [University of Maryland, College Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Maryland,_College_Park "University of Maryland, College Park").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-indiatimes.com-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-6)

He married his girlfriend, actress [Kanchi Kaul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanchi_Kaul "Kanchi Kaul") on 27 November 2011.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-knotty-2) In 2014 they had a son,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-7) and in 2016, they had another son.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-8)

**Shabir Ahluwalia** (born 10 August 1979) is an Indian actor and host who works in Hindi television and films. He is best known for portraying Abhishek Prem Mehra in [Zee TV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zee_TV "Zee TV")'s romantic drama series _[Kumkum Bhagya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kumkum\_Bhagya "Kumkum Bhagya")_. He won the third season of _[Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fear\_Factor:\_Khatron\_Ke\_Khiladi "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi")_ and hosted _[Nach Baliye](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nach\_Baliye "Nach Baliye")_, _[Guinness World Records – Ab India Todega](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guinness\_World\_Records\_%E2%80%93\_Ab\_India\_Todega "Guinness World Records – Ab India Todega")_ and _[Dancing Queen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing\_Queen\_(2008\_Indian\_TV\_series) "Dancing Queen (2008 Indian TV series)")_.

Apart from this, Ahluwalia has acted in _[Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyunki\_Saas\_Bhi\_Kabhi\_Bahu\_Thi "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi")_ (2002), _[Kya Hadsaa Kya Haqeeqat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kya\_Hadsaa\_Kya\_Haqeeqat "Kya Hadsaa Kya Haqeeqat")_ (2004), _[Kahi To Milenge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahi\_To\_Milenge "Kahi To Milenge")_ (2002), _[Kkavyanjali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kkavyanjali "Kkavyanjali")_ (2005), _[Kasamh Se](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasamh\_Se "Kasamh Se")_ (2006), _[Kasautii Zindagii Kay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasautii\_Zindagii\_Kay\_(2001\_TV\_series) "Kasautii Zindagii Kay (2001 TV series)")_ (2006), _[Kayamath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kayamath "Kayamath")_ (2007), _[Laagi Tujhse Lagan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laagi\_Tujhse\_Lagan "Laagi Tujhse Lagan")_ (2011) and many more. He made his debut in [Bollywood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bollywood "Bollywood") with _[Shootout at Lokhandwala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shootout\_at\_Lokhandwala "Shootout at Lokhandwala")_. His second film was _[Mission Istanbul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission\_Istanbul "Mission Istanbul")_.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-sify1-4)

## Life and family

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shabir_Ahluwalia&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Life and family")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Kanchi_kaul_shabbir_ahluwalia_Bollywood_%26_TV_actors_at_Ekta_Kapoor%27s_birthday_bash.jpg/250px-Kanchi_kaul_shabbir_ahluwalia_Bollywood_%26_TV_actors_at_Ekta_Kapoor%27s_birthday_bash.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Kanchi_kaul_shabbir_ahluwalia_Bollywood_&_TV_actors_at_Ekta_Kapoor's_birthday_bash.jpg)

With wife [Kanchi Kaul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanchi_Kaul "Kanchi Kaul") at [Ekta Kapoors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor") Birthday

Shabir Ahluwalia was born on 10 August 1979 to a [Sikh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sikh "Sikh") father and a [Catholic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic "Catholic") mother in [Mumbai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mumbai "Mumbai").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-birth-1) He has two siblings Shefali Ahluwalia and Sameer Ahluwalia. He did his schooling from [St. Xavier's High School, Vile Parle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Xavier's_High_School,_Vile_Parle "St. Xavier's High School, Vile Parle").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-indiatimes.com-5) He completed his graduation from [University of Maryland, College Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Maryland,_College_Park "University of Maryland, College Park").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-indiatimes.com-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-6)

He married his girlfriend, actress [Kanchi Kaul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanchi_Kaul "Kanchi Kaul") on 27 November 2011.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-knotty-2) In 2014 they had a son,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-7) and in 2016, they had another son.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shabir_Ahluwalia#cite_note-8)

**Sakshi Tanwar** (pronounced[[ˈsaːkʂi ˈt̪əɳʋəɾ]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/Hindi_and_Urdu "Help:IPA/Hindi and Urdu"); born 12 January 1973) is an Indian actress and presenter, who primarily works in Hindi films and television. Known for her portrayals of strong-willed, unconventional women in Indian television, Tanwar is considered among the highest-paid [television actresses](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Hindi_television_actresses "List of Hindi television actresses") in India.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-highest-paidd-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-highest-paid-2) She is a recipient of several awards including two [ITA Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Television_Academy_Awards "Indian Television Academy Awards") and one [Filmfare OTT Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filmfare_OTT_Awards "Filmfare OTT Awards").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dob-3) She has appeared in _[Forbes India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes\_India "Forbes India")_'s[Celebrity 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_Celebrity_100 "Forbes Celebrity 100") list of 2012.

Tanwar is widely recognised for her portrayal of Parvati Agarwal in _[Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahaani\_Ghar\_Ghar\_Kii "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii")_ (2000-2008) and Priya Sharma Kapoor in _[Bade Achhe Lagte Hain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bade\_Achhe\_Lagte\_Hain "Bade Achhe Lagte Hain")_ (2011-2014), both these performances earned her two [Indian Television Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Television_Academy_Awards "Indian Television Academy Awards"). Tanwar made her film debut in 2006 with _O re Manva_ and has since appeared in the biographical sports drama _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_ (2016) and the historical drama _[Samrat Prithviraj](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samrat\_Prithviraj "Samrat Prithviraj")_ (2022). Alongside her work in television, Tanwar received praises for the series — _[Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karrle\_Tu\_Bhi\_Mohabbat "Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat")_ (2017-2019), _[Mission Over Mars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission\_Over\_Mars "Mission Over Mars")_ (2019) and _[Mai: A Mother's Rage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai\_(TV\_series) "Mai (TV series)")_ (2022), the latter won her the [Filmfare OTT Award for Best Actress Critics – Drama Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filmfare_OTT_Awards "Filmfare OTT Awards").[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-4)

## Early life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life")]

Tanwar was born on 12 January 1973[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dob-3)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-u897-5) to Rajendra Singh Tanwar, a retired [CBI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Bureau_of_Investigation "Central Bureau of Investigation") officer, in a middle-class [Rajput](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajput "Rajput")[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-6) family from [Alwar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alwar "Alwar"), [Rajasthan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajasthan "Rajasthan"), India. She was educated in many [Kendriya Vidyalayas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kendriya_Vidyalaya "Kendriya Vidyalaya") before graduating from [Lady Shri Ram College](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Shri_Ram_College "Lady Shri Ram College") in [New Delhi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Delhi "New Delhi"). Prior to this, in 1990, after completing her [pre-university course](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pre-university_course "Pre-university course"), she worked as a sales trainee at a five-star hotel.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-7) In college, she was the secretary and president of the dramatic society.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] After graduation, while preparing for the entrance tests to the administrative services and mass communications, she gave an audition for the national broadcaster [Doordarshan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doordarshan "Doordarshan")'s film songs based program _Albela Sur Mela_ in 1998; she was selected as the presenter.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

### Established television actress (1999–2014)

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Established television actress (1999–2014)")]

After her television debut in 1998 with _Albela Sur Mela_, Tanwar rose to fame with [Ekta Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor")'s _[Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahaani\_Ghar\_Ghar\_Kii "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii")_ (2000–2008).[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dnaindia-8) The series based on joint family, saw her portray Parvati Agarwal opposite [Kiran Karmarkar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiran_Karmarkar "Kiran Karmarkar").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-9) The series was a major success and earned her recognition. Her performance was also praised by several critics.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-12) The series earned her several nominations including [ITA Award for Best Actress – Popular](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ITA_Award_for_Best_Actress_Drama_Popular "ITA Award for Best Actress Drama Popular") and won her the [Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Telly_Award_for_Best_Actress_in_a_Lead_Role "Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role").[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-14)

Tanwar then played Maya Mittal in _[Kutumb](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kutumb\_(TV\_series) "Kutumb (TV series)")_, the lead Gayatri Sharma in _[Devi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devi\_(TV\_series) "Devi (TV series)")_, Advocate Indira Bhargav in _[Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jassi\_Jaissi\_Koi\_Nahin "Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin")_ and [Ganga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ganga_(goddess) "Ganga (goddess)") in _[Kahaani Hamaaray Mahaabhaarat Ki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahaani\_Hamaaray\_Mahaabhaarat\_Ki "Kahaani Hamaaray Mahaabhaarat Ki")_.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-16) In 2010, she hosted the second season of _[Crime Patrol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crime\_Patrol\_(TV\_series) "Crime Patrol (TV series)")_.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-17)

Tanwar later established herself with Ekta Kapoor's _[Bade Achhe Lagte Hain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bade\_Achhe\_Lagte\_Hain "Bade Achhe Lagte Hain")_ (2011–2014). She portrayed Priya Sharma Kapoor, a woman who marries in her late 30s opposite [Ram Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram_Kapoor "Ram Kapoor").[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-19) The series was a massive success and her performance earned her critical acclaim.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-21) The series won her several awards including [ITA Award for Best Actress – Jury](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ITA_Award_for_Best_Actress_Drama_Jury "ITA Award for Best Actress Drama Jury") and [Indian Telly Award for Best Actress – Jury](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Telly_Award_for_Best_Actress_in_a_Lead_Role "Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role").[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-22) In 2012, she made an appearance on the reality show _[Kaun Banega Crorepati](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaun\_Banega\_Crorepati "Kaun Banega Crorepati")_.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-23)

### Film and web expansion (2015–present)

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Film and web expansion (2015–present)")]

In 2015, Tanwar made her Marathi film debut with _[Katyar Kaljat Ghusali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katyar\_Kaljat\_Ghusali\_(film) "Katyar Kaljat Ghusali (film)")_, which was a critical and commercial success.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-25)

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e0/Aamir_Khan%2C_Sakshi_Tanwar%2C_Nitesh_Tiwari_on_the_sets_of_Dangal.jpg/250px-Aamir_Khan%2C_Sakshi_Tanwar%2C_Nitesh_Tiwari_on_the_sets_of_Dangal.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Aamir_Khan,_Sakshi_Tanwar,_Nitesh_Tiwari_on_the_sets_of_Dangal.jpg)

Tanwar on the sets of _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_, with actor [Aamir Khan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aamir_Khan "Aamir Khan") and director [Nitesh Tiwari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nitesh_Tiwari "Nitesh Tiwari")

Tanwar returned to Hindi films with _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_ (2016), where she portrayed Daya Kaur, wife of former wrestler [Mahavir Singh Phogat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahavir_Singh_Phogat "Mahavir Singh Phogat") opposite [Aamir Khan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aamir_Khan "Aamir Khan").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-26)[Anupama Chopra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anupama_Chopra "Anupama Chopra") said in her review that Tanwar provides "strong support" to the story.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-27) While, [Sukanya Verma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sukanya_Verma "Sukanya Verma") found her to be terrific.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-28) The film was a major commercial success with an estimated gross of ₹2,000 crore and became the [highest-grossing Indian film ever](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_Indian_films "List of highest-grossing Indian films").[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-30)

In 2017, Tanwar made her web debut with _[Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karrle\_Tu\_Bhi\_Mohabbat "Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat")_, playing a doctor opposite Ram Kapoor.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-31) In 2018, she returned to television with _Tyohaar Ki Thaali_.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-32) Tanwar then went onto play a priest's wife opposite [Sunny Deol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunny_Deol "Sunny Deol") in _[Mohalla Assi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohalla\_Assi "Mohalla Assi")_ (2018), a police officer's wife opposite [Manoj Bajpayee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manoj_Bajpayee "Manoj Bajpayee") in _[Dial 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dial\_100\_(2021\_film) "Dial 100 (2021 film)")_ (2021) and [Jayachandra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jayachandra "Jayachandra")'s wife opposite [Ashutosh Rana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ashutosh_Rana "Ashutosh Rana") in _[Samrat Prithviraj](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samrat\_Prithviraj "Samrat Prithviraj")_ (2022).[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-33)[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-34)[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-35) In 2019, she appeared in two web series: _[The Final Call](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Final\_Call\_(TV\_series) "The Final Call (TV series)")_ as an air controller officer and _[M.O.M. - Mission Over Mars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission\_Over\_Mars "Mission Over Mars")_ as a scientist.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-36)

Later in 2022, Tanwar played a grieving mother who take revenge for her daughter's death in the series _[Mai: A Mother's Rage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai\_(TV\_series) "Mai (TV series)")_.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-37) Nandini Ramnath of _[Scroll.in](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scroll.in "Scroll.in")_ noted, "Tanwar, cast against type, admirably interprets her character to the best of her abilities. She brings softness and empathy to an increasingly violent and profanity-ridden saga of vigilante justice."[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-38) The series earned her nomination at [Filmfare OTT Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Filmfare_OTT_Awards "2022 Filmfare OTT Awards") for Best Actress – Drama Series and won her the Best Actress Critics – Drama Series.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-39)

In 2024, Tanwar played a coaching institute teacher in the film _[Sharmajee Ki Beti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sharmajee\_Ki\_Beti "Sharmajee Ki Beti")_.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-40) Monika Rawal Kukreja called her performance "earnest" and added, "She brings the perfect balance while emoting strength and vulnerability".[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-41) In 2025, Tanwar played a royal queen in the series _[The Royals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Royals\_(2025\_TV\_series) "The Royals (2025 TV series)")_.[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-42) Pallavi Keswani of _[The Hindu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Hindu "The Hindu")_ stated that she brings more to the table despite limited screentime.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-43)

## Other work and media image

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Other work and media image")]

[![Image 7](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b9/Sakshi_Tanwar_at_the_success_party_of_%E2%80%98Dangal%E2%80%99.jpg/250px-Sakshi_Tanwar_at_the_success_party_of_%E2%80%98Dangal%E2%80%99.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Sakshi_Tanwar_at_the_success_party_of_%E2%80%98Dangal%E2%80%99.jpg)

Tanwar at _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_'s success party in 2017

With her performances in _Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii_, _Kutumb_, _Devi_ and _Bade Achhe Lagte Hain_, Tanwar established herself among the leading and highest-paid actresses of Hindi television.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-highest-paidd-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-highest-paid-2)_[Rediff.com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rediff.com "Rediff.com")_ placed her first in its "Top TV stars of 2006" and tenth in its "Top 10 television actresses" list.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-46) Supriya Sharma of _[India Today](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India\_Today "India Today")_ termed her the "nation's most-loved telly star".[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-47) Tanwar is termed as one of the hottest television actress by Rediff.com.[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-48) In 2022, _[Forbes India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes\_India "Forbes India")_ included her in its first ever "Showstoppers – India's Top 50 Outperformers" list.[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-49)

In 2012, Tanwar appeared in _[Forbes India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes\_India "Forbes India")_'s[Celebrity 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_Celebrity_100 "Forbes Celebrity 100") list, ranking 93rd with an estimated annual income of ₹34.5 million (US$360,000).[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-50) Her on-screen pairing with [Ram Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram_Kapoor "Ram Kapoor") was voted as "Television's most popular onscreen couple", in an _[India Today](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India\_Today "India Today")_ survey.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-51) In April 2013, in a survey conducted by _Ormax Media_, Tanwar featured in the "Top 5 most trustworthy celebrities" list.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dnaindia-8) In a 2014 poll conducted by _[Shaadi.com](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shaadi.com "Shaadi.com")_, Tanwar and Kapoor were voted the _Favourite TV Couple_ by 42.3% Indians.[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-Jan-IBNLive-52) Tanwar is also a celebrity endorser for brands and products such as [Vim](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vim_(cleaning_product) "Vim (cleaning product)"), [Harpic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harpic "Harpic"), [Tanishq](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanishq "Tanishq"), [Kellogg's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kellogg's "Kellogg's") and [Big Bazaar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Bazaar "Big Bazaar"). _[Economic Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Economic\_Times "The Economic Times")_ termed her the "second-most visible celebrity on television", in 2016.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-53)

**Sakshi Tanwar** (pronounced[[ˈsaːkʂi ˈt̪əɳʋəɾ]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/Hindi_and_Urdu "Help:IPA/Hindi and Urdu"); born 12 January 1973) is an Indian actress and presenter, who primarily works in Hindi films and television. Known for her portrayals of strong-willed, unconventional women in Indian television, Tanwar is considered among the highest-paid [television actresses](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Hindi_television_actresses "List of Hindi television actresses") in India.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-highest-paidd-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-highest-paid-2) She is a recipient of several awards including two [ITA Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Television_Academy_Awards "Indian Television Academy Awards") and one [Filmfare OTT Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filmfare_OTT_Awards "Filmfare OTT Awards").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dob-3) She has appeared in _[Forbes India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes\_India "Forbes India")_'s[Celebrity 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_Celebrity_100 "Forbes Celebrity 100") list of 2012.

Tanwar is widely recognised for her portrayal of Parvati Agarwal in _[Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahaani\_Ghar\_Ghar\_Kii "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii")_ (2000-2008) and Priya Sharma Kapoor in _[Bade Achhe Lagte Hain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bade\_Achhe\_Lagte\_Hain "Bade Achhe Lagte Hain")_ (2011-2014), both these performances earned her two [Indian Television Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Television_Academy_Awards "Indian Television Academy Awards"). Tanwar made her film debut in 2006 with _O re Manva_ and has since appeared in the biographical sports drama _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_ (2016) and the historical drama _[Samrat Prithviraj](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samrat\_Prithviraj "Samrat Prithviraj")_ (2022). Alongside her work in television, Tanwar received praises for the series — _[Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karrle\_Tu\_Bhi\_Mohabbat "Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat")_ (2017-2019), _[Mission Over Mars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission\_Over\_Mars "Mission Over Mars")_ (2019) and _[Mai: A Mother's Rage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai\_(TV\_series) "Mai (TV series)")_ (2022), the latter won her the [Filmfare OTT Award for Best Actress Critics – Drama Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filmfare_OTT_Awards "Filmfare OTT Awards").[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-4)

## Early life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life")]

Tanwar was born on 12 January 1973[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dob-3)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-u897-5) to Rajendra Singh Tanwar, a retired [CBI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Bureau_of_Investigation "Central Bureau of Investigation") officer, in a middle-class [Rajput](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajput "Rajput")[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-6) family from [Alwar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alwar "Alwar"), [Rajasthan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rajasthan "Rajasthan"), India. She was educated in many [Kendriya Vidyalayas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kendriya_Vidyalaya "Kendriya Vidyalaya") before graduating from [Lady Shri Ram College](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Shri_Ram_College "Lady Shri Ram College") in [New Delhi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Delhi "New Delhi"). Prior to this, in 1990, after completing her [pre-university course](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pre-university_course "Pre-university course"), she worked as a sales trainee at a five-star hotel.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-7) In college, she was the secretary and president of the dramatic society.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] After graduation, while preparing for the entrance tests to the administrative services and mass communications, she gave an audition for the national broadcaster [Doordarshan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doordarshan "Doordarshan")'s film songs based program _Albela Sur Mela_ in 1998; she was selected as the presenter.[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

### Established television actress (1999–2014)

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Established television actress (1999–2014)")]

After her television debut in 1998 with _Albela Sur Mela_, Tanwar rose to fame with [Ekta Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekta_Kapoor "Ekta Kapoor")'s _[Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahaani\_Ghar\_Ghar\_Kii "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii")_ (2000–2008).[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-dnaindia-8) The series based on joint family, saw her portray Parvati Agarwal opposite [Kiran Karmarkar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiran_Karmarkar "Kiran Karmarkar").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-9) The series was a major success and earned her recognition. Her performance was also praised by several critics.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-12) The series earned her several nominations including [ITA Award for Best Actress – Popular](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ITA_Award_for_Best_Actress_Drama_Popular "ITA Award for Best Actress Drama Popular") and won her the [Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Telly_Award_for_Best_Actress_in_a_Lead_Role "Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role").[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-14)

Tanwar then played Maya Mittal in _[Kutumb](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kutumb\_(TV\_series) "Kutumb (TV series)")_, the lead Gayatri Sharma in _[Devi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devi\_(TV\_series) "Devi (TV series)")_, Advocate Indira Bhargav in _[Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jassi\_Jaissi\_Koi\_Nahin "Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin")_ and [Ganga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ganga_(goddess) "Ganga (goddess)") in _[Kahaani Hamaaray Mahaabhaarat Ki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahaani\_Hamaaray\_Mahaabhaarat\_Ki "Kahaani Hamaaray Mahaabhaarat Ki")_.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-16) In 2010, she hosted the second season of _[Crime Patrol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crime\_Patrol\_(TV\_series) "Crime Patrol (TV series)")_.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-17)

Tanwar later established herself with Ekta Kapoor's _[Bade Achhe Lagte Hain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bade\_Achhe\_Lagte\_Hain "Bade Achhe Lagte Hain")_ (2011–2014). She portrayed Priya Sharma Kapoor, a woman who marries in her late 30s opposite [Ram Kapoor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram_Kapoor "Ram Kapoor").[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-19) The series was a massive success and her performance earned her critical acclaim.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-21) The series won her several awards including [ITA Award for Best Actress – Jury](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ITA_Award_for_Best_Actress_Drama_Jury "ITA Award for Best Actress Drama Jury") and [Indian Telly Award for Best Actress – Jury](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Telly_Award_for_Best_Actress_in_a_Lead_Role "Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role").[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-22) In 2012, she made an appearance on the reality show _[Kaun Banega Crorepati](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaun\_Banega\_Crorepati "Kaun Banega Crorepati")_.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-23)

### Film and web expansion (2015–present)

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sakshi_Tanwar&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Film and web expansion (2015–present)")]

In 2015, Tanwar made her Marathi film debut with _[Katyar Kaljat Ghusali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katyar\_Kaljat\_Ghusali\_(film) "Katyar Kaljat Ghusali (film)")_, which was a critical and commercial success.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-25)

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e0/Aamir_Khan%2C_Sakshi_Tanwar%2C_Nitesh_Tiwari_on_the_sets_of_Dangal.jpg/250px-Aamir_Khan%2C_Sakshi_Tanwar%2C_Nitesh_Tiwari_on_the_sets_of_Dangal.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Aamir_Khan,_Sakshi_Tanwar,_Nitesh_Tiwari_on_the_sets_of_Dangal.jpg)

Tanwar on the sets of _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_, with actor [Aamir Khan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aamir_Khan "Aamir Khan") and director [Nitesh Tiwari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nitesh_Tiwari "Nitesh Tiwari")

Tanwar returned to Hindi films with _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal\_(2016\_film) "Dangal (2016 film)")_ (2016), where she portrayed Daya Kaur, wife of former wrestler [Mahavir Singh Phogat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahavir_Singh_Phogat "Mahavir Singh Phogat") opposite [Aamir Khan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aamir_Khan "Aamir Khan").[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-26)[Anupama Chopra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anupama_Chopra "Anupama Chopra") said in her review that Tanwar provides "strong support" to the story.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-27) While, [Sukanya Verma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sukanya_Verma "Sukanya Verma") found her to be terrific.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-28) The film was a major commercial success with an estimated gross of ₹2,000 crore and became the [highest-grossing Indian film ever](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_Indian_films "List of highest-grossing Indian films").[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-30)

In 2017, Tanwar made her web debut with _[Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karrle\_Tu\_Bhi\_Mohabbat "Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat")_, playing a doctor opposite Ram Kapoor.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-31) In 2018, she returned to television with _Tyohaar Ki Thaali_.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-32) Tanwar then went onto play a priest's wife opposite [Sunny Deol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunny_Deol "Sunny Deol") in _[Mohalla Assi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohalla\_Assi "Mohalla Assi")_ (2018), a police officer's wife opposite [Manoj Bajpayee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manoj_Bajpayee "Manoj Bajpayee") in _[Dial 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dial\_100\_(2021\_film) "Dial 100 (2021 film)")_ (2021) and [Jayachandra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jayachandra "Jayachandra")'s wife opposite [Ashutosh Rana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ashutosh_Rana "Ashutosh Rana") in _[Samrat Prithviraj](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samrat\_Prithviraj "Samrat Prithviraj")_ (2022).[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-33)[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-34)[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-35) In 2019, she appeared in two web series: _[The Final Call](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Final\_Call\_(TV\_series) "The Final Call (TV series)")_ as an air controller officer and _[M.O.M. - Mission Over Mars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission\_Over\_Mars "Mission Over Mars")_ as a scientist.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-36)

Later in 2022, Tanwar played a grieving mother who take revenge for her daughter's death in the series _[Mai: A Mother's Rage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai\_(TV\_series) "Mai (TV series)")_.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-37) Nandini Ramnath of _[Scroll.in](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scroll.in "Scroll.in")_ noted, "Tanwar, cast against type, admirably interprets her character to the best of her abilities. She brings softness and empathy to an increasingly violent and profanity-ridden saga of vigilante justice."[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-38) The series earned her nomination at [Filmfare OTT Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Filmfare_OTT_Awards "2022 Filmfare OTT Awards") for Best Actress – Drama Series and won her the Best Actress Critics – Drama Series.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-39)

In 2024, Tanwar played a coaching institute teacher in the film _[Sharmajee Ki Beti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sharmajee\_Ki\_Beti "Sharmajee Ki Beti")_.[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-40) Monika Rawal Kukreja called her performance "earnest" and added, "She brings the perfect balance while emoting strength and vulnerability".[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-41) In 2025, Tanwar played a royal queen in the series _[The Royals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Royals\_(2025\_TV\_series) "The Royals (2025 TV series)")_.[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-42) Pallavi Keswani of _[The Hindu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Hindu "The Hindu")_ stated that she brings more to the table despite limited screentime.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakshi_Tanwar#cite_note-43)
